title: Independent control machine HTTPS server configuration
description: Optional top-level machine_server group in control configuration. Omit the entire group for legacy shared HTTPS Admin routing. Presence requires all four fields; null is not omission. Structural canonical identity/collision checks and actual pinned TLS material validation belong to the Go configuration owner. No defaults or enable bypass are supplied.

listen_address.description: Explicit canonical host:port bind with numeric port1..65535 and bracketed IPv6. Different from the browser listener; actual socket alias conflicts are also refused before serving. No DNS/IP alias rewriting or default.

origin.description: Exact canonical HTTPS origin, distinct from both browser origins. DNS/localhost/IPv4/bracketed IPv6 and the selected nondefault port retain identity. Go rejects credentials, paths, explicit default443 and ambiguous host spellings.

tls_certificate_file.description: Canonical absolute certificate-chain reference, distinct from the private key. No certificate bytes in configuration; startup uses the shared pinned bounded1MiB pair reader, validity and exact machine-origin SAN verification.

tls_private_key_file.description: Canonical absolute protected private-key reference. No key material in configuration or environment. OS-readable private0400/0600 single-link regular input, pinned through the shared bounded TLS snapshot; no group/other permissions, symlink or verification bypass.
